text:
to: value investors club
subject: overlooked/misunderstood asset, special sit, event-driven, complexity, orphan stock, no true comps, "self-help" story w/ levers to pull to unlock equity value
ticker: spcx

catalyst path:
>spin out xai and divest non-core Starlink segment, removing conglomerate discount and reducing complexity

>present non-GAAP stock chart (temporary, GIPS-compliant)

>figure out where solarcity went, do a bunch of related party transactions until all the debt and liabilities end up over there

>sale-leaseback rocketship assets, stockpile with Starlink proceeds, wait for burry to tweet his put strike and expiry, and then announce a 25% ASR and dutch tender

>put Malone on remainco board, rename to $LSPCX, and use "outsider" capital allocation to de-lever the balance sheet; this is done by shifting the spaceship debt "outside the country," and onto some unsuspecting Peruvian cable TV provider

>SOTP valuation: valuing X at TWTR's FCF multiple yields $0, and valuing the AI segment at OpenAI's FCF multiple also yields $0. However, valuing the AI segment at 1x Anthropic = $1T, and valuing X at 1x Google = $4T, for a price target of $5T.

>net net, even at half a Google, we see 60% upside to shares. (please see below for model*)

(4 + 1 = 5)
